title: Dār al-Rusūkh — College of Qur'ānic and Islamic Sciences
description: A distance-learning college teaching the Qur'ān, Arabic and the Islamic sciences on the classical matn ladder — ḥalaqāt capped at twelve, examined in writing and aloud, concluding in the certification ladder and ijāzah with a named, unbroken chain.

title: The College — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Why the College is named for rootedness, why it teaches wholly at a distance by design, who founded it, and which offices answer for it.

title: Faculties — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Four faculties — the Qur'ān, Arabic, Sharī'ah sciences, and Applied & Professional studies — each a ladder of named classical texts, taught in order and examined aloud.

title: Kulliyyat al-Qur'ān — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Eleven rungs from al-Qā'idah al-Nūrāniyyah to ijāzah in the ten qirā'āt: Tajwīd on Tuḥfat al-Aṭfāl and al-Jazariyyah, three Ḥifẓ tracks, consolidation, and the chain.

title: Awards & Ijāzah Policy — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: The four-award certification ladder for those whose knowledge has never been recognised, examined at 70% in writing and aloud — and the ijāzah policy governing chains conferred by this house.

title: The Register of Chains — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Which chains this College holds, through whom they came, and which teachers may confer them — published rather than furnished on request, vacancies included.

title: Short Courses & Ramaḍān Intensives — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Seven examined short courses of four to eight weeks, each mapping onto a rung of the main ladder, plus the Ramaḍān intensive programme and free memorisation schedules.

title: Fees, Payment Plans & Kafālah — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Four tiers from ₦8,000 a month, payable monthly, per term or per year, in naira or dollars — with pause rights, family and teacher rates, and the zakāh-funded kafālah scheme.

title: Admissions — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Five stages from enquiry to your first ḥalaqah. Placement is by assessment and is free, and it happens before any fee is discussed.

title: Academic Calendar — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Three terms kept against the Hijrī year, with the general timetable pausing in Ramaḍān for intensives. Class times in West Africa Time with an explicit UTC offset.

title: Verify a Credential — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: Check any certificate, transcript or ijāzah issued by the College against its reference number. Public, free, and answered without the holder's involvement.

title: Contact — Dār al-Rusūkh
description: The Registry, the Bursary, the Academic Council and the Foundation — every office of the College by name, with office hours in West Africa Time.
